sections.content: To arrange a meeting, ask mikor? (when?), answer with a day in its -n form or a time, then confirm with találkozunk + day-n — 'we'll meet on ...'.
találkozunk is the 'we' form of találkozik (to meet) — a whole sentence packed into one word, exactly the kind of shortcut that makes arranging plans in Hungarian quick once you have it memorised.
